full_judgment: 3. Meanwhile, the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Rev.), Chittagong by his order dated June 3, 1973 declared the aforesaid land as abandoned land under Section 92 (1C) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. A Miscellaneous Case No. 2/72-73 was filed by the appellant-company claiming that the land in question was leased out to it who have been possessing the same on payment of rent. The appellant-company also moved the Secretary, Ministry of Land Administration and Land Reforms, Government of Bangladesh. The objections were, however, not entertained by the respondents. The appellant-company then moved the High Court under Article 102 of the Constitution challenging the impugned order on the ground that Section 92 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act did not apply to the facts of the case. The respondents, namely, the Government of Bangladesh, the Deputy Commissioner, Chittagong and the Circle Officer, Fatikchari entered appearance by filing an affidavit-in-opposition. It was contended by them that the land in dispute was settled with one Hiralal Mukherjee, Manager of the Tea Estate, in his personal capacity and not as manager of the Tea Estate. Further, in 1950 Hiralal Mukherjee relinquished all his claims to the land in favour of a different parson namely, M/s. Union Agency Ltd. under a registered deed of relinquishment. A mutation case, being case No. 2/1 of 1950-51, was filed by M/s. Union Agency Ltd. for recording its name as owner in possession of the land. After notices were served upon parties concerned including the appellant-company and the Manager of the Ramgarh Tea Estate all of whom supported its claim, the mutation case was allowed and M/s. Union Agency Ltd. was recorded as tenant. After mutation the land was recorded as Jote No. 164 under a separate Khatian No. 1/36. Since Union Agency Ltd. left the country without making any arrangement for payment of rent the land became abandoned under Section 92 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act and was rightly declared to be so by the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Rev.), Chittagong.
